Name: Grandpa's Ghost
Author: ch0opera
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://cdn.nest.rip/uploads/cdb808f8-3f90-4c80-a5ea-8015defaf196.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center][left][font=Times New Roman][color=#999999][size=4]Leaves rustle outside, dancing and twirling around your feet as you open your front door. You can barely make out the lingering scents of cinnamon and vanilla and pie crust wafting from the kitchen. The farmhouse settles around you with creaks and the rattling of that pesky sideboard you've been meaning to nail down, and the soft susurration of tree branches brushing against the house remind you that only a few days of Fall remain. So much to do to ready the farm for Winter. Another season, almost over. But wait...what was that sound?

﻿It's the week before Spirit's Eve, a time when the veil between the worlds is thin, granting spirits more power and ability to affect the physical plane.[/size][/color][/font][/left][font=Times New Roman]
[size=4][color=#999999]
[/color][i][color=#999999][b]Do you believe in ghosts?
[/b][/color][/i][/size]

[center][size=6]👻   [i][b][color=#674ea7] SPECIAL ITINERARY [/color][/b][/i]  🗓[/size]

[size=4][color=#999999]Grandpa's Ghost will haunt your farm every night during the last week of Fall. You may also find him lurking about a few other locations throughout the week.[/color]
[/size]
[size=3][color=#999999][spoiler]
Sun (21 Fall): Grandpa's Ghost arrives (intro event at Farmhouse)
Mon-Fri (22-26 Fall): Backwoods, Beach, Cindersap Forest, Mountain, Museum, Pierre's shop, Pelican Town, Railroad, Saloon
Sat (27 Fall): Spirit's Eve Festival
Sun (28 Fall): Grandpa's Ghost departs (outro event at Bus Stop)

Hauntings will occur on the farm daily, from 8 PM - 2 AM. All other hauntings will occur throughout the day at various locations.
[/spoiler][/color][/size][/center]
